title: Extraction of high quality RNA from Gardnerella species
author: Andy Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-2568/v1

steps.title: Prepare Workstation and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare an RNase-free environment and set equipment temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Wipe pipets, microcentrifuge, and work bench with RNase AWAY.
Use RNase-free consumables and reagents.
Set microcentrifuge to 4°C.
Preheat heating block to 72°C.
If using TapeStation for analysis: thaw RNA ScreenTape Ladder on ice and equilibrate Sample Buffer and RNA ScreenTape at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and solutions for each cell pellet (< 1 x 10^9 bacteria).

substeps.instruction: Lysis Buffer with 2-mercaptoethanol: Prepare 700 µL of freshly prepared Lysis Buffer with 1% (v/v) 2-mercaptoethanol (add 10 μL of 2-mercaptoethanol for each 1 mL Lysis Buffer).
Wash Buffer II with Ethanol: Add 16 mL 96–100% ethanol to the provided Wash Buffer II, mark the label, and store at room temperature.

Lysozyme Solution (200 µL per sample): Mix 2 µL 1M Tris pH 8.0 (RNase-free), 185.2 µL 0.1M EDTA (RNase-free), 0.8 µL lysozyme (250 mg/mL in 10 mM Tris pH 8.0, RNase-free), 2 µL mutanolysin (10,000 U/mL), and 10 µL proteinase K (20 mg/mL).
PureLink DNase Mixture (80 µL per sample): Mix 8 µL 10X DNase I Reaction Buffer, 10 µL Resuspended DNase (~3 U/µL), and 62 µL RNase Free Water.

steps.title: Harvest Bacterial Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest log-phase bacteria (< 1 x 10^9) and pellet the cells.

substeps.instruction: Transfer bacteria to an appropriately sized microcentrifuge tube, keeping tubes on ice.
Centrifuge at 2000 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Lyse the cell pellet and homogenize the resulting lysate.

substeps.instruction: Set microcentrifuge to 25°C.
Add 200 µL of prepared lysozyme solution to the pellet and resuspend by pipetting up and down while keeping samples on ice.
Vortex all tubes for 10-15 seconds.
Add 0.5 µL 10% SDS solution to all samples while on ice and vortex to mix.
Incubate lysate for 15 minutes in a 37°C water bath.
Add 700 µL Lysis Buffer (with 2-mercaptoethanol) and vortex for 10-15 seconds.
Homogenize the lysate by passing it 5 times through a 25G x 5/8” needle attached to a syringe.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate and Bind RNA
steps.instruction: Remove debris and bind the RNA to the Spin Cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 12,000 x g for 2 minutes at 25°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a clean RNase-free microcentrifuge tube.
Add 250 µL 100% ethanol to the supernatant and vortex thoroughly to disperse any precipitate.
Transfer 700 µL of the sample (including precipitate) to a Spin Cartridge with a Collection Tube.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 15 seconds at 25°C.
Discard flow-through and repeat the transfer and centrifugation process until all remaining homogenate has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash and DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Wash the bound RNA and remove contaminating DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL Wash Buffer I to the Spin Cartridge; centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 15 seconds at 25°C.
Discard flow-through and Collection Tube; insert Spin Cartridge into a new Collection Tube.
Add 80 µL PureLink DNase mixture directly onto the membrane surface.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature (or in a microcentrifuge set at 25°C).
Add 350 µL Wash Buffer I; centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 15 seconds at 25°C.
Discard flow-through and reinsert the Spin Cartridge into the same Collection tube.

steps.title: Final Wash and Elution
steps.instruction: Perform final washes and elute the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Wash Buffer II with ethanol to the Spin Cartridge; centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 15 seconds at 25°C.
Discard flow-through and reinsert the Spin Cartridge into the same Collection tube.
Repeat the Wash Buffer II step once more.
Centrifuge the Spin Cartridge at 12,000 x g for 1 minute at 25°C to dry the membrane.
Discard the Collection Tube and reinsert the Spin Cartridge into a Recovery Tube.
Add 30 µL – 100 µL RNase-Free Water (30 µL maximizes yield) to the center of the cartridge.
Incubate at room temperature (or in a microcentrifuge set at 25°C) for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 1 minute at 25°C.
